The proposed ref T > alt G binding direction is therefore an untested hypothesis, not an observed effect.
The variant is intronic and does not overlap an annotated cCRE. It could only act through an unproven distal effect on the dELS 42 bp away; no allele-specific regulatory assay is supplied.
PYDC2 is the nearest protein-coding gene at 19.5 kb, but no chromatin-contact, reporter, perturbation, or eQTL evidence connects this variant or the nearby dELS to PYDC2.
The mechanism is proposed in HCT116, the supplied expression context. There is no positive HCT116 evidence for CTCF occupancy at this site; ENCODE HCT116 has zero TF ChIP-seq peaks over the variant.
Altered PYDC2 regulation is hypothesized to affect colorectal cancer biology, but there is no GWAS, eQTL, Open Targets, or direct variant-specific colorectal cancer evidence supporting this link.
